title: Perfect-Matching Search in Deterministic NC (General Graphs)
exact_target: Can perfect matchings be found deterministically in general graphs by uniform polynomial-size circuits of polylogarithmic depth?

sources.citation: Svensson and Tarnawski, The Matching Problem in General Graphs is in Quasi-NC, introduction; FGT Section 2.1 defines Search-PM; Nanongkai–Scquizzato Section 2.2 fixes logspace-uniform NC.
